project: ZebPay SIP - The Squirrel in Ram Setu
model_note: Seedance 2.0 image-to-video on Higgsfield, SILENT (generate_audio=false). No dialogue, no lip-sync on any clip. Every Mode C shot = locked START keyframe (+ optional END keyframe) + one prompted camera move + attach ONLY the character(s) in that shot.
vo: single external ElevenLabs Indian-English narrator track, verbatim from 00_input_script_HUMAN.md, added in the edit (NOT per-clip)
reel_note: reel_approx windows are an APPROXIMATE pacing proposal only. The VO is one continuous unedited track; final per-shot durations are set at timeline assembly. Do not fail a shot on reel timing alone.
definition_of_done: PASS = zero FAILED blocker criteria across all shots AND the final-timeline blockers. MAJOR fails are triaged by the Director (fix vs accept). MINOR fails are polish. Every needs-human criterion (motion smoothness, identity-drift-through-motion, contact/no-fuse, exact stripe-stability, VO quality) MUST be confirmed by the video-reviewer's AV senses (Higgsfield video-analysis for motion, Whisper/UTMOS for the VO) on playback; stills alone cannot close them. A shot with any unresolved needs-human blocker is NOT done.

severity_legend.blocker: ship-stopper: wrong/broken hero identity, fused/melted contact, morph where a locked still was specced, garbled legible text, wrong brand logo, wrong/garbled VO. Batch or ad is unshippable.
severity_legend.major: visible defect likely in photoreal; should fix; Director may accept with reason.

checkable_legend.frame: provable from one or more stills / the bible sheet / the attached reference (reviewer cites the frame).
checkable_legend.needs-human: requires playback or ear: motion smoothness, jitter/flicker, morph-through-motion, contact-zone fuse, identity drift across the clip, exact stripe stability, VO quality. Stills and transcripts cannot prove it. The video-reviewer confirms via Higgsfield video-analysis / Whisper / UTMOS.

global_mode_c_criteria.text: frame is native 9:16 vertical (1080x1920), full-frame, no letterbox/pillarbox/stretch.

photoreal grounded-mythic texture per the direction bible (weathered stone, hand-forged metal, real fabric weave, dust/ember/spray, skin pores, fine fur, film grain). Does NOT read as smooth/plasticky/over-rendered/uncanny CGI or illustration.
NO model-burned words/letters/captions/subtitles/watermarks/UI anywhere in frame (Seedance in-video text is unreliable; all text is Mode B).
warm golden-hour, high-contrast grade with crushed true blacks and protected warm highlights (Nolan warm register). Not cool/desaturated, not flat/washed.
the START/first frame is clean: no pre-existing warped hand, extra/fused digit, asymmetric/melted face, or artifact that motion will amplify (Seedance faithfully amplifies first-frame defects).
EXACTLY the one specced camera move for this shot; the model invented NO second move (no added pan/zoom/orbit/tilt beyond the one specced).
smooth, constant-speed motion; no jitter, no temporal flicker, no strobing brightness, no speed ramp the spec did not call for.
no melt/morph/smear of subject or props through the motion; no extra or fused limbs/digits; hands/paws not warped; no object pops in or out of existence.

final_timeline_criteria.text: the single VO track speaks the EXACT frozen script (00_input_script_HUMAN.md), in order, verbatim, nothing added/dropped/reworded.
no voiced punctuation: the ellipsis in 'And... decided to make a point of it' is a PAUSE, not spoken 'dot dot dot'; no garbled dash/hyphen artifacts; clean Indian-English pronunciation.
ONE consistent narrator voice across the entire ad (not multiple voices; the reason Seedance native audio was rejected).
music bed present per the scored arc (Zimmer/Rahman mythic orchestral), sits UNDER the VO so narration stays intelligible; no lyrics with words.
IF karaoke/captions are burned in the final, they render the exact script, correctly spelled, placed clear of the subject/logo; and NO stray Seedance-burned text survives from any clip.
VO sentences land over their intended shots per the pacing proposal (alignment reads natural; no line orphaned over the wrong visual).

scenes.line: Across this ocean waited a battle for dharma. Sita had to be brought home. Ravana had to fall.
scenes.intent: PILOT + establish. A lone divine hero (Rama) before a vast sea; sets the reverent, mythic register. Confirms both the Rama drift ceiling AND that a photoreal deity face clears the Seedance content filter before any other Rama shot is batched.

criteria.text: Rama's face, crown, jewelry, skin tone and attire MATCH the Rama bible sheet (matched to the SHEET, never re-derived from this or any video frame). This shot does NOT define the lock; the sheet does.
no visible Rama identity drift through the push-in: face structure, crown, jewelry and skin tone stable start-to-end (within the drift ceiling; any morph of facial features = FAIL).

the photoreal deity face rendered intact and was NOT blocked, blurred, or mangled by the Seedance content filter (pilot gate: if the face is filtered/garbled, STOP and re-approach before batching other Rama shots).
Dhanush (bow) present in Rama's hand, correct single form, not warped/duplicated/floating.
heroic wide, low angle, Rama centered at full-height with headroom, at the shore facing the sea/horizon.
single slow push-in only; hair and cloth drift in wind; no invented second move.
reads reverent / heroic / solemn (god-ray backlight, divine gravitas), NOT menacing, stern or casual. Beat reads (a divine hero before a vast sea) without the VO.

scenes.line: And to get there, an army would build what had never been built before. A bridge across the sea.
scenes.intent: Scale: a massed vanara army gathered behind Rama; the impossible task about to begin.

criteria.text: a massed vanara crowd (thousands) gathered on the shore behind Rama; reads as one determined army.
crowd kept distant and loose; NO individual non-human vanara face brought to macro (photoreal non-human crowd faces warp up close).
EXACTLY one move = a single slow aerial pull-back. NOT a crane-up-plus-dolly-back two-move (audit finding 6). Any second move = FAIL.
the pull-back reveals scale (army + worksite widening into frame); the beat reads as 'a vast impossible build begins' without the VO.

scenes.line: Stone by stone. Boulder by boulder. Each one marked with Ram's name, and his faith.
scenes.intent: Work begins in force: a single boulder hurled, thunderous splash.
refs: none (or vanara arms at frame edge); attach bridge-state ref (empty sea / first boulders)

criteria.text: NO legible 'Ram's name' or any readable letters/script on any boulder (Seedance garbles text; the VO carries the name). Any marking must be illegible/distant or absent; a legible burned name = FAIL.
a single large boulder arcing, ending on a large water-splash plume at sea impact.
the boulder stays large and readable through the arc; it does NOT vanish, tear, or float mid-flight (fast-motion + water-physics failure).
the splash reads as real water physics (rising plume), not a torn/smeared/frozen sheet or a melting artifact.
wide, eye level, static with only a slight tilt following the arc (one move).

scenes.line: And in the middle of all that grandeur, something much smaller had also arrived.
scenes.intent: Establish the squirrel: tiny, humble, watching the giants work. Sets the squirrel identity read.

criteria.text: the squirrel MATCHES the squirrel bible sheet: Indian palm squirrel, correct body/face/proportion; three faint stripes present and correctly placed (matched to the sheet, not a video frame).
three stripes present at the correct positions per bible (this is the baseline for later stripe-stability checks).
squirrel small in frame against the vast construction (scale contrast, small-creature POV).
wide-to-medium, low/eye level, single slow push-in; small head turn toward the work; no second move.
reads curious / humble / a small arrival amid grandeur, NOT a cartoon/comic mascot.

scenes.line: It couldn't carry boulders.
scenes.intent: The squirrel picks up a tiny pebble, straining at the weight: it does what it can.

criteria.text: squirrel identity and three stripes stable through the motion, matching S2-a / bible; no drift.
a single small pebble present, ending held in the squirrel's mouth; the pebble does NOT vanish, float, or duplicate.
reads as a pick-up with a slight strain (the weight), not an effortless grab.
medium close-up, eye level, gentle push-in, telephoto shallow DoF, squirrel large.

scenes.line: So it carried what it could.
scenes.intent: The squirrel places the pebble carefully into a gap between two boulders.

criteria.text: squirrel identity and stripes stable vs bible through the motion.
the pebble goes from the squirrel's mouth into the gap between two boulders; set into the gap by the end; does not vanish/warp.
reads as careful placement, then the squirrel drawing back.
the boulder gap matches the attached bridge-state reference (same evolving structure).

scenes.line: Of course, one of the vanaras noticed.
scenes.intent: The squirrel again at the gap with its pebble, focused: sets up the mockery.

criteria.text: squirrel identity and stripes stable through the motion.
pebble in mouth nudged toward the gap; survives (no vanish/warp).
close-up, eye level, gentle push-in, telephoto, squirrel large.

scenes.line: And... decided to make a point of it.
scenes.intent: Establish the boastful lead vanara: hoists a massive boulder, flexes, glares down. Playful-mockery register.

criteria.text: the lead vanara MATCHES the vanara bible sheet (this shot establishes the vanara lock; keep it for S3-c continuity).
hoists a massive boulder onto the shoulder and flexes; the boulder does not warp/float/vanish through the lift.
medium wide, low angle (he looms), slow push-in, harder chiaroscuro.
hands/fingers gripping the boulder are anatomically correct: no warp, no extra/fused digits.
reads as boastful show-off / playful mockery (comedic bravado, glaring down), NOT heroic-divine and NOT horror-menace.

scenes.line: He made sure everyone laughed with him.
scenes.intent: The same vanara grins, a boulder in each hand, chest out: the crowd-pleasing boast.
refs: lead vanara bible sheet (SAME as S3-b)

criteria.text: reads as the SAME lead vanara as S3-b (same reference, similar framing): face/build/attire continuous across the two beats.
a boulder raised in each hand, broad grin, chest out.
both hands grip a boulder each: not warped/fused, no extra digits.
playful-mockery grin (comedic), NOT menace/threat.

scenes.line: Even the babies were outdoing it without breaking a sweat.
scenes.intent: Comic contrast: a baby vanara strolls past, casually carrying a decent stone, unbothered.

criteria.text: a baby vanara (matches the baby vanara ref), carrying a decent-sized stone.
strolls across frame mid-stride, casual/unbothered; the stone is stable (no vanish/warp).
medium wide, eye level, single slow tracking move with the stroll.
reads casual/effortless (comic contrast to the squirrel's strain), not straining.

scenes.line: Naturally, nobody clapped.
scenes.intent: HIGH-RISK comedy peak: the vanara holds the squirrel's pebble at the squirrel's face and flicks it away, deadpan. Tight two-subject frame. Pilot with a slightly larger stone and a slow short flick; two-shot cutaway is the fallback.

criteria.text: BOTH identities intact and UN-BLENDED in the shared tight frame: the lead vanara (fingers/face) matches the vanara bible AND the squirrel matches the squirrel bible; no hybrid/merged creature.

the pinched stone SURVIVES the flick: present pinched at the squirrel's face in the start, still large and near-frame mid-arc at the end; it does NOT vanish, warp, or smear (fast small-object failure, the #1 risk of this shot).
no identity blend or morph between the vanara and the squirrel THROUGH the motion (contact-proximity morph).
tight two-shot, macro-telephoto, the vanara's fingers and the squirrel's face share the frame; eye level; static with a slight tilt on the flick (one move).
the vanara's flicking fingers are not warped, no extra/fused digits.
deadpan/flat vanara plus the squirrel's small reaction: comedic dismissal (nobody clapped), NOT cruel or horror.

PROCESS: if the stone warps/vanishes or the identities blend by attempt 2, this must fall back to the two-shot cutaway (macro insert of fingers flicking a stone, no squirrel + a separate squirrel-reaction cutaway). Flag, do not force-pass a broken tight take.

scenes.line: But someone else was watching too.
scenes.intent: Rama reappears and notices the squirrel; the register turns warm/reverent. Identity MUST match his Scene-1 appearance.
refs: Rama bible sheet (1 to 3 most consistent refs; NEVER re-derive from the S1-a video frame)

criteria.text: Rama matches the Rama bible sheet (face/crown/jewelry/skin tone/attire), matched to the SHEET, not to any video frame.
reads as the SAME Rama as S1-a (continuous crown, face, attire, skin tone) so his reappearance is unbroken.
no Rama identity drift through the push-in (within ceiling); any facial-feature morph = FAIL.
bow in hand present, correct single form, not warped/duplicated.
medium, eye level, slow push-in, telephoto isolating Rama, god-ray backlight; eyeline settles down toward the squirrel.
reads reverent / warm / quietly watching (the divine notices the humble), NOT stern or menacing.

scenes.line: And he wasn't looking at the boulders.
scenes.intent: Rama walks toward the squirrel; the laughter fades. Identity must survive the walk.

criteria.text: Rama identity and attire stable through the walk vs the bible / S1-a; no drift across the tracking move.
natural walking motion; legs/feet not warped; no melt/morph through the tracking move.
medium wide, eye level, single slow tracking move with him, telephoto.
reads as Rama walking toward the squirrel and beginning to lower.

scenes.line: He was looking at the only one who showed up without being asked to.
scenes.intent: HARDEST shot (pilot first). Rama's flat palm on the ground with the squirrel already at its edge; the palm lifts slightly as the squirrel settles in. Macro on the hands, Rama's FACE OUT of frame. Small settle, NOT a ground-to-palm teleport.

criteria.text: the squirrel sits IN/at the palm as a SEPARATE body; palm and squirrel do NOT fuse, melt, or merge at the contact zone at any point.
the motion is a small settle-and-slight-lift (squirrel already at the palm edge in the start frame); NOT a ground-to-palm teleport/jump (large layout delta = the confirmed morph driver).
Rama's FACE is OUT of frame the whole clip (macro on the hands only); if a Rama face enters frame = FAIL (there must be no face to drift).
Rama's hand/palm/fingers anatomically correct: not warped, no extra/fused digits, no floating detached fingers.
the squirrel and its stripes stay intact and un-morphed at the palm.
macro on the hands, eye level, very slow push-in, telephoto shallow DoF.
reads tender / reverent contact (the chosen one held gently), not clinical or awkward.

scenes.line: Some bridges are built with strength. Some are built with heart. The wise ones know you need both.
scenes.intent: Rama's two fingers stroke down the squirrel's back. The three stripes stay faint and STABLE in-clip; the brightening reveal is a Mode B post overlay, NOT a generated in-clip morph.

criteria.text: the three stripes stay STABLE and unchanged in-clip: NO in-clip stripe morph, brighten, grow, or reveal (the reveal is a Mode B post overlay). If the stripes animate/change within the generated clip = FAIL.
the fur/back texture along the stroke path does NOT smear (named motion-blur feature-smear artifact).
Rama's face is OUT of frame (extreme close-up on the back + fingers only).
the two fingers / hand are not warped, no extra digits.
the squirrel's back/coat matches the bible; no identity morph through the stroke.
reads as two fingers stroking gently down the back (single micro push-in).

scenes.line: Some days the sea was calm.
scenes.intent: Montage beat 1: on a calm sea the squirrel returns and picks up a pebble.

criteria.text: squirrel identity and stripes stable through the motion.
calm/still water reads (matches 'some days the sea was calm'); clear contrast to S5-b.
ends with a pebble in the squirrel's mouth; the pebble survives (no vanish/float).
medium, low/eye level, slow tracking, telephoto, squirrel large.

scenes.line: Some days it wasn't.

criteria.text: squirrel identity and stripes stable in the water; no morph through the surf.
the squirrel's paws stay visibly in contact with wet sand/rock; it does NOT read as floating or disappearing in the surf (named small-subject-in-water failure).
rough surf / waves read (clear contrast to the calm S5-a).
struggles forward and reaches firmer ground with spray; reads as effort-but-still-goes.

scenes.line: The squirrel never waited for the right day.
scenes.intent: Montage beat 3: the squirrel wedges a pebble into the lengthening pebble line.

criteria.text: squirrel identity and stripes stable through the motion.
a lengthening line of same-size pebbles; the new pebble is wedged in and survives (no vanish/warp).
matches the attached bridge-state ref (half-built + pebble line).
reads as wedging the pebble in, then drawing back.

scenes.line: It didn't matter if the tide was high or low that day. The pebble went in anyway.
scenes.intent: The growing bridge: boulders on one side, a lengthening line of same-size pebbles wedged between them. Slow pan reveals the structure.
refs: bridge-state ref (half-built + pebble line), no character

criteria.text: the bridge matches the attached bridge-state ref (boulders one side, lengthening same-size pebble line) and reads as the SAME evolving structure as S2-c/S5-c (continuity).
a single slow pan along the pebble line only; no second move.
the pebbles are roughly the same size along the line (script requirement, the SIP metaphor).
the structure does not morph, shift, or grow/melt during the pan (it is a reveal by camera, not a build).

scenes.mode: B (O2 approved: Ken-Burns on locked still); C fallback
scenes.line: One pebble, placed once, means nothing. The same pebble, placed again and again, regardless of the day, that's what holds a bridge together.
scenes.intent: Payoff macro: slow push into the gap where the pebbles now sit, load-bearing, indistinguishable from the boulders. Rendered as a Mode B Ken-Burns/parallax push on a LOCKED macro still (O2 approved). NO morph of pebbles into boulders.
refs: locked macro still of the pebble-filled gap (bridge-state completed)

criteria.text: pebbles do NOT morph/melt into boulders; the ONLY change across the clip is the camera push (crop/scale). Content pixels are otherwise a static locked still. Any content transformation = FAIL. (If rendered Mode C instead of Mode B, this is a hard BLOCKER and all Mode C globals also apply.)
macro of the pebble-filled gap; the pebbles read as now load-bearing and indistinguishable from the surrounding boulders (the metaphor payoff).
smooth, constant-speed Ken-Burns push; no jitter, no parallax tearing.
no burned text on the still.

scenes.line: You don't need to time the market. You need to keep showing up, same amount, every time. That's not a squirrel's trick. That's SIP.
scenes.intent: The payoff hero shot (the money frame). The completed golden bridge, wide; the squirrel perched on one of its own now-fused pebbles. Triumphant register.

criteria.text: the squirrel is large enough to hold identity and matches the squirrel bible (body + three stripes); it sits on a pebble fused into the structure.
the completed golden bridge matches the completed bridge-state ref (the same structure, now finished).
extreme wide, low-angle heroic, anamorphic wide; the squirrel readable atop its pebble; golden light.
reads triumphant / golden payoff (the humble one atop the finished bridge); the beat lands without the VO.
single slow push-in with golden-light shimmer; near-static (light + breath only); no second move, no morph.

scenes.line: Most people wait for the right time to invest. The market down, wait. The market up, too late. The squirrel never checked the tide before showing up. [Pause.] It showed up the same way, every time, and let the average take care of the rest.
scenes.intent: The parallel: a clean, calm transition (kinetic type or a calm abstract field) that carries the investing thought with no mythology. Rendered deterministically (Remotion/HyperFrames), zero generation credits.

criteria.text: a clean transition with NO mythology visuals: calm kinetic type or a calm abstract field for the VO to sit on.
IF any on-screen text is shown, it renders the exact intended words (from V17/V18), correctly spelled, no typos.
text is legible, on-brand type, high contrast, clear of frame edges.
card timing holds under the VO with the Pause beat (V17, pause, V18); nothing cuts before its line finishes.
rendered Mode B (Remotion/HyperFrames): NO generative artifacts (no morph/warp/melt criteria apply, this is deterministic).
